_comment: Crisis support phrase list (11/02/2026). The SAME file lives at frontend/src/lib/crisisPhrases.json - change both together (test_crisis_support.py fails when they differ). Patterns run on normalized text: lower case, apostrophes dropped, every other character that is not a letter or digit turned into one space. Keep to regex syntax that Python and JavaScript read alike. An exclusion is cut out of the text before the patterns run, so a training course title never trips the card while a real message beside it still does. Workplace injury words alone (hurt myself, cut myself) are NOT patterns: injury reports use them every day; only intent (want to, thinking about, on purpose) counts. Version 2 (review, 11/02/2026): life insurance or a life policy, suicide doors, lanes, squads, sprints and drills, die cut, die cast and die set, cut myself a break or some slack, and end it all at 5pm are never matches.
patterns: \b(?:everyone|everybody|they|the world|my family|my kids) (?:would be|is|are|will be) better off without me\b

\b(?:want|wanna|going|planning|plan|thinking about|thinking of|thoughts of|urge to|urges to|feel like) (?:to )?(?:hurt|harm|cut|hurting|harming|cutting|kill|killing) my ?self\b(?! (?:a|an|some|another) (?:break|breaks|slack|slice|piece|deal|check|cheque|bit|little|portion)\b)
